name: Ambrai Ghat
description: Best sunset viewpoint in Udaipur. Views of City Palace, Jag Mandir, and Lake Palace from across Pichola.

name: Bagore Ki Haveli
description: 18th-century haveli on Lake Pichola with 138 rooms. Evening Dharohar folk dance show is a must-see.

name: City Palace
description: Largest palace complex in Rajasthan overlooking Lake Pichola.

name: Fateh Sagar Lake
description: Artificial lake with Nehru Island Park in the center. Boating with City Palace and Aravalli Hills views.

name: Jag Mandir Island Palace
description: Island palace on Lake Pichola. Shah Jahan took refuge here — inspiration for the Taj Mahal design.

name: Jagdish Temple
description: Massive Indo-Aryan temple built in 1651 with intricate carvings. Dedicated to Lord Vishnu as Jagannath.

name: Lake Pichola Boat Ride
description: Sunset boat ride past Jag Mandir and the Lake Palace Hotel.

name: Monsoon Palace (Sajjangarh)
description: Hilltop palace at 944 meters. Built to watch monsoon clouds. Panoramic sunset views of the lake city.

name: Saheliyon Ki Bari
description: Garden of Maidens built for 48 women of the queen's retinue. Lotus pools, marble elephants, fountains.

name: Shilpgram
description: Rural arts and crafts complex with 26 traditional huts. Live demonstrations of pottery, weaving, and painting.

name: Agra Fort
description: Massive red sandstone Mughal fortress with marble palaces inside. Shah Jahan was imprisoned here.

name: Fatehpur Sikri
description: UNESCO World Heritage Mughal capital built by Akbar (1571-1585). Buland Darwaza — world's tallest gateway.

name: Itimad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
description: Exquisite Mughal tomb with pietra dura inlay work. Called "Baby Taj" as a precursor to the Taj Mahal.

name: Mehtab Bagh
description: Mughal garden across the Yamuna from the Taj Mahal. Best sunset view of the Taj without crowds.

name: Taj Mahal
description: The ultimate symbol of love. Mughal marble mausoleum. Best at sunrise. Closed Fridays.

name: Brahma Temple
description: One of the very few temples in the world dedicated to Lord Brahma. Red spire with silver turtle on dome.

name: Pushkar Camel Fair Ground
description: Site of the world's largest camel fair held every November. Year-round you can see the grounds.

name: Pushkar Lake & Ghats
description: Sacred lake surrounded by 52 ghats. Evening aarti ceremony. Believed to appear from lotus dropped by Brahma.

name: Rangji Temple
description: Unique Dravidian-style gopuram temple in Rajasthan. Blend of South Indian, Rajput, and Mughal architecture.

name: Savitri Temple
description: Hilltop temple reached by rope way or 400+ steps. Panoramic views of Pushkar Lake and town at sunset.

name: Hanuman Garhi
description: Hilltop temple with 76 steps. Largest temple in Ayodhya before Ram Mandir. Panoramic city views.

name: Ram Mandir
description: Grand temple at the birthplace of Lord Rama. Newly built Nagara-style temple inaugurated in 2024 with stunning architecture.

name: Saryu River Ghats
description: Ancient ghats along the Saryu River. Evening aarti ceremony and boat rides.

name: Dirang Dzong
description: Ancient stone fortress of the Monpa tribe. Still inhabited village inside with traditional stone houses.

name: Dirang Hot Springs
description: Natural hot water springs along the road. Locals use them for bathing and washing.

name: Sangti Valley
description: Beautiful valley known for black-necked cranes in winter. Apple orchards and traditional Monpa settlements.

name: Char Dukan
description: Four iconic shops dating back to 1920s. Famous for Maggi, omelettes, and chai with valley views. Ruskin Bond's favorite.

name: Lal Tibba Landour
description: Highest point of Mussoorie-Landour at 7,464 ft. Telescope to spot Himalayan peaks on clear days.

name: Ruskin Bond's Landour Walk
description: Walking trail past the famous author's home, through deodar forests and heritage British-era buildings.

name: Kala Bhavana (Art College)
description: Art school with murals by Nandalal Bose, Binode Behari Mukhopadhyay, and other Bengal School masters.

name: Uttarayan (Tagore Museum)
description: Five houses where Tagore lived and wrote. Personal effects, manuscripts, and paintings on display.

name: Visva-Bharati University
description: University founded by Rabindranath Tagore in 1921. Open-air classrooms under trees, Tagore's vision.

name: Palamau Tiger Reserve Visitor Centre
description: Visitor information, forest guides, and safari bookings. Tiger spotting probability highest Nov–Mar.

name: Palamu Fort Ruins
description: 3km forest trail to abandoned Mughal-era fort ruins. Wildlife spotting en route.

name: Dawar Village
description: Main settlement of Gurez with traditional log houses and bridges over Kishanganga River. Near LOC.

name: Habba Khatoon Peak
description: Named after the famous Kashmiri poetess. Dramatic pyramid-shaped peak dominating the Gurez skyline.

name: Yumthang Valley (Valley of Flowers)
description: River valley at 11,800 ft carpeted with rhododendrons in April-May. Hot springs and yak pastures.

name: Zero Point (Yumesamdong)
description: Snow point at 15,300 ft where the road ends. Surrounded by glaciers and complete silence.

name: Mamleshwar Temple
description: Ancient Shiva temple across the river from Omkareshwar. Second of the two Jyotirlinga temples here.

name: Omkareshwar Temple
description: One of 12 Jyotirlingas on an Om-shaped island in the Narmada. Ancient temple with stunning river setting.

name: Coronation Bridge
description: Historic bridge over the Teesta River connecting plains to hills. Gateway to Darjeeling and Sikkim.

name: Mahananda Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense forest sanctuary near Siliguri with leopards, elephants, and diverse birdlife.

name: Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense sal forest sanctuary with leopards, wild boar, and sambar deer. Guided jeep safaris.

name: Drass War Memorial
description: Kargil War memorial in the second-coldest inhabited place on Earth. Gallery of soldier tributes.

name: Modhera Sun Temple
description: 1026 AD Solanki-era marvel. Surya Kund stepped tank with 108 shrines. Sun hits the inner sanctum at equinox.

name: Shnongpdeng River Camping
description: Camping on the banks of the crystal-clear Umngot River. Cliff jumping, kayaking, and snorkeling.
